Key design decisions: Node::$dom made public (required by SelectorParser); Node::$children and $nodes made nullable ?array (required for clear() to set null); Parser::clear() uses null assignment instead of unset() on typed properties; Settings::getMaxFilesize() falls back to MAX_FILE_SIZE constant at runtime

comments.note: Node::$dom must be public (not private as in original) because SelectorParser needs to access it. This is a minor API surface change but doesn't break any tests since no test directly accesses $node->dom.

Settings::$settings initialized as empty array []; getMaxFilesize() falls back to MAX_FILE_SIZE constant at runtime. The original class initialized with ['max-filesize' => MAX_FILE_SIZE] but that constant isn't available at static property init time in a PSR-4 loaded class.
Parser::load_file() still uses func_get_args() pattern for Phase 1 backward compatibility. Phase 2 should convert to proper variadic signature.
